notes.title: Major Patch Note 0.1.06.00 – Lovers' Festival and New NPC Quests!
notes.content:
Update 0.1.06.00.

A little later than expected, but it’s finally here! This update marks the introduction of the NPC quest system. To celebrate the Lovers' Festival event, we’re introducing our very first NPC who can deliver quests. This is just the beginning... the best is yet to come!


🎉 New Features

 NPC Quest System 🏆

 Added interactive NPCs with dialogues and missions.

 "Love in the Air" Event 💖

 New event product: box of chocolates (with random variations).
 Romantic theme added to store customizations for the event.
 Special rewards: Romantic Trophy 2025.



🛠️ Improvements

 Store Cleaning 🧹

 The delay before cleaning is now more random.
 Dirt accumulates twice as slowly as before.



🐛 Fixes

 Various minor bug fixes


Enjoy the new features and the Lovers' Festival event! ❤️

notes.title: Update 0.1.05.00 – Customer Mood Tracking & Market Prices
notes.content:
Update 0.1.05.00  

New Features  
  
 A new section in the statistics window now allows real-time tracking of customer mood. Players can easily identify factors influencing customer satisfaction or dissatisfaction.  
 A new button on the computer provides access to market prices. This feature displays the average selling prices of products, offering a reference for typical customer-accepted prices. Players are free to set their own pricing strategies.  
  

Improvements  
  
 The environment has been adjusted to better integrate waste introduced in the previous update.  
 Floor cleaning is now faster for improved gameplay fluidity.  
  

Fixes  
  
 Fixed an issue affecting the recycler.  
 Tooltips for certain computer buttons now display correctly.  
 Player-set selling prices now display correctly on the pricing page.  
 Various minor fixes and adjustments.  
  

Thank you for your support and feedback! Keep sharing your ideas and enjoy the game.  
Instinc'Team Studio

notes.title: Major Update 0.1.04.00 - Waste and Cleanliness at the Heart of Gameplay!
notes.content:
Update 0.1.04.00 - January 17, 2025

New Features

Customer Waste

 Customers occasionally drop trash.
 Pick them up by hand (up to 5 at a time) and throw them in the trash can.
 A new key (default E) has been added to allow secondary interactions, such as waste management.

Dirt in the Store

 Floors gradually get dirty where customers walk.
 Use a broom to clean these visible stains that appear over time.

New Voices and Customer Comments
More diversity and immersion in audio dialogues.

Empty Cartons
You can now pick up an empty carton behind the recycling bin.

Cleaning
A cleaning option allows you to remove lost or inaccessible cartons. It is activated by the Delete key, but you can change this shortcut in the controls menu.

New Achievements Available
Two new achievements related to the new features.

Daily Tips
New tips appear during loading screens.

Improvements

 Overhaul and improvement of certain UI elements.
 Customers enter more quickly and frequently without hesitation.
 Performance optimization by streamlining client-related scripts.


Fixes

 Fixed translations in German.
 Resolved a bug displaying currency in the supply sale window.
 Disabled crouching while carrying supplies or during specific actions.
 Various minor fixes and adjustments.


🌟 Get ready for an even more fun and immersive experience in your favorite supermarket!

Instin'Team Studio

notes.title: Customization and Optimization: New Translations and Improvements
notes.content:
Published on January 10, 2025

Hello everyone!

We are excited to present update 0.01.02.09012025, which comes with many new features, improvements, and fixes thanks to your valuable feedback. We hope these changes will enhance your gaming experience and bring even more enjoyment!

New Features

 New "Wood Design" collection: A new style of supplies, unlockable by leveling up the player.
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45318083/df2e0b3a2a1a4d57c88aee7c7c64ba38ec3c0f33.png
 Photo Mode: Players can now enter photo mode by hiding the interface by pressing the H key (modifiable in control options).
 Improved Level System: Leveling up is now more interactive and displays some rewards obtained.
 Translations in testing:

 German: Translation added, though there may be errors (automatic translation used for now). Please report any mistakes.
 Japanese: Translation available despite a label display bug. We aim to provide a localized experience for our Japanese players while awaiting a fix.
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45318083/320505c5de95a481e912b1f9cf74019a53fe4891.jpg
Current bug on Japanese translation: https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45318083/b43db15dabd7c344d535eedfe26b08d546f7792d.png
Please note regarding the translated languages:
We sincerely apologize for the absence of some translations, particularly for Asian languages (Chinese, Korean, etc.). Adding a new language to the game takes considerable time, which explains the delay. We kindly ask for some patience before these languages are added, but rest assured we are committed to adding them to the game. They will be available in the near future.
 English voiceovers: The narrator and clients now speak in English if the selected language is not French.
 Added additional voice/comments for clients.
 Added 5 new products.


Improvements and Adjustments

 Supply prices lowered.
 Improved supply style organization on PC to better differentiate each skin.
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45318083/b140777e9faccb8c0969e3879a2deb294457406d.png
 "Alpha Early Access" special figure available again until the Beta release.
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45318083/3e4bdaa0157e8ba0fbe53a7b5d99e27385f0bd33.png
 Improved translation system to better integrate languages with special characters.
 UI element design modifications.
 Adjusted client satisfaction gain which had become too easy to achieve.


Bug Fixes


 Clients showing no interest no longer display a happy emoji above their heads.
 Clients not entering the store fixed: They no longer head towards the entrance before leaving.
 Client voiceovers: Fixed voices when they leave the store.
 Bug with placing boxes on racks fixed.
 Daily lottery freeze bug fixed.
 Maximum number of clients on the map increased after earning a reputation star.
 Various minor bug fixes.


Thank you again for your valuable feedback! Thanks to you, we've been able to improve the gaming experience and make important adjustments.

We continue to work hard to improve the game and provide the best experience possible for our community.
Stay tuned for more updates.

The Instinc'Team Studio Team

notes.title: Delivery Reinvented and Exciting New Features on the Horizon!
notes.content:
Published on January 2, 2025

Patch Notes 0.1.03.02012025

New Delivery System

 Cartons are now delivered to ground drop zones:

 4 zones dedicated to product cartons, each capable of holding up to 80 cartons.
 1 zone for supply cartons, with a maximum capacity of 24 cartons.

 New zone management mechanics:

 After each delivery, an occupied zone must be cleared before ordering again.

 For example, if a delivery includes 2 rack cartons, you cannot place another supply order until the drop zone is cleared, even if space is available elsewhere.

 Order limits:

 You can no longer order more than 80 product cartons at a time (fully occupying a drop zone).
 Supply orders are also limited to 24 cartons per order.



With this new functionality, your management experience will reach a whole new level. 🚛
However, as with any new system, bugs may occur. If you encounter any, don’t hesitate to report them to me. Your feedback is invaluable for quick fixes.

Minor Fixes

 Footsteps now display correctly on refrigerators.


Changes

 Christmas theme deactivated.
 Profile banners in the UI updated.


Coming Soon

 Cleaning system: development is ongoing to allow removal of cartons that might have appeared in inaccessible zones due to the old drop system.
 New features on the way:

 English voice quests.
 New missions.
 Obtainable new shelf skins.
 And more!



Florian - Instinc'Team Studio

notes.title: Important Update
notes.content:
Released on December 24, 2024

Major Overhaul:
The quest system has been completely overhauled to improve the game's overall flow and coherence. This update requires a reset of saved games to ensure a smooth transition to the new system.

Reset Details:
 Reset: Your progress in the adventure.
 Kept: Your trophies, previously obtained collectibles, as well as your achievements and accomplishments.

This change was necessary due to the incompatibility between the old and new quest systems. Players will now enjoy a more optimized experience and better quest tracking.

To compensate for this restart, financial aids have been added at the beginning of the adventure and upon completing certain quests. This modification marks an important step in improving the overall gameplay.

We thank players for their patience and understanding during this essential transition. Measures are being taken to prevent such resets in the future.

Various Improvements:
 Overall Performance: Improved overall performance for a smoother experience, especially on modest configurations.
 Sales Counter: Added a visible tracker for the mission requiring 10,000 sales.
 Price Balancing: Adjusted prices of certain supplies and products for better economic coherence.
 Reputation: Modified the thresholds needed to access the sale of certain products.
 Secrets: Revised validation conditions for a specific type of secret.
 Customer Satisfaction: Adjusted parameters influencing customer satisfaction.
 Translations: Added missing translations to improve the multilingual experience.
 Lottery: Removed past event products from lottery rewards.
 Computer: Kept the computer open after the daily lottery starts to prevent accidental closures.
 Price Modification: Removed the need to press Enter to confirm a price change before saving.
 Financial Aids: Added new financial aids at the beginning of the adventure and after certain quests.

Bug Fixes:
 Resolved several minor bugs to improve the overall stability of the game.

New Features:
 Depot Door: The depot door can now be opened with a single click, in addition to the red button.
 Missions: Introduced new missions to enrich the gameplay.
 Event Display: Styles, products, and supplies related to special events now have distinct displays on the computer.
 Product Type: Displays the product type during purchase to indicate the necessary supplies for its sale.

We are committed to continuing to improve Superhero Market with your valuable feedback. Thank you for your constant support, and happy adventuring! 🦸‍♂️🛒

Instinc'Team Studio

notes.title: 20122024.01 | Bugfix Performance
notes.content:
Hello players,

Thank you for your valuable feedback, which helps us improve Superhero Market. Here are the details of today's corrective update:


Fixes and Improvements


 Mouse sensitivity fix:

 An adjustment has been made to address the issue of excessive or insufficient sensitivity encountered by some players, including cases where the cursor wouldn't move due to overly low sensitivity.


 Performance improvements:

 Significant optimizations to reduce slowdowns and improve smoothness in beach, park, and store areas
 Engine optimization to ensure better stability and shorter loading times
 Performance-intensive lights have been temporarily disabled
 DLSS 3 is now enabled and configurable in the settings to enhance performance and fluidity
 Environment adjustments to lighten the loading process
 A new option allows disabling light "cast shadows" to reduce graphic load and increase FPS


 Temporary deactivation of ceiling themes:

 Due to compatibility issues, ceiling themes are temporarily replaced by the default theme. They will be reactivated in a future patch once the fixes are applied.


 Minor fixes:

 Added an on-screen FPS counter to monitor performance
 Gift items no longer have collisions to prevent blockages
 Various bugs have been fixed for a smoother experience



We will continue to listen to your feedback and work to make your gaming experience even better.

Thank you for your support, and happy managing your supermarket!

Instinc'Team Studio
